activity.notes: Decebalus was the last king of Dacia. His accession is conventionally placed around 86/87 CE, while his death and the Roman conquest of Dacia occurred in 106. ATLAS therefore stores c.87 as an approximate accession boundary and 106 as the secure end of his rule.

sources.title: Decebalus, king of Dacia — Oxford Classical Dictionary
sources.citation_text: Oxford identifies Decebalus as king of Dacia and records his wars with Rome, his final defeat, suicide, and the creation of the Roman province of Dacia in 106.

sources.title: Dacia — Encyclopaedia Britannica, 11th edition
sources.citation_text: The Britannica article places Decebalus' accession in the 86–87 CE range and describes his rule through the Roman conquest period.
